author: gtavi_countdown

Today marks 24 years since Rockstar released GTA Vice City. Here are all references found in GTA 6:

- Vice City cover girl poster in Jason and Lucia’s house
- Vice City release date (29.10.02) engraved on Lucia’s revolver
- Raul Bautista wearing the same outfit as Lance Vance
- Reference to Phil Cassidy, who was an arms dealer in Vice City
- Tommy Vercetti shirt pattern as a weapon skin included as a pre-order bonus
- Love Fist reference in the Extended Look
- V-Rock and Flash FM radio stations, which are returning

We got Reinforcement learning from neural feedback before GTA 6

This demo uses brain signals as feedback to adjust an AI-generated face toward a viewer’s preferences, without a pre-collected preference dataset.

I don’t know if I like the implications of this because  you could have a hyper gooner implication of just reward maximizing the prettiest girl in your VR

The reward model however uses embeddings and k-nearest neighbors. Still very interesting research
